name: Library Pack Browser
description: Browse, import and manage Excalidraw .excalidrawlib libraries per profile; insert items or save a selection.
author: Excalibur (first-party)

panels.title: Library Pack Browser
panels.body: Manage `.excalidrawlib` packs from the **Libraries** panel: import packs, insert their items onto the canvas, or save the current selection into a library. Libraries are stored per profile.
